headline: Names a post office building in Oakland, New Jersey, after Frank Leone.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 332 Ramapo Valley Road in Oakland, New Jersey, as the "Frank Leone Post Office." It is a naming measure only. It does not change how the post office operates, its services, or its staff.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 21, 2018, and the new name applies from that date.
